moments.text: Infrared sensor view looking down on grey sea, with dark circular shading around the crosshair and a lighter smudge near the top.
A large ship slides through the view from the bottom edge to the top, passing just under the crosshair.
The same ship passes through again, from the lower left to the top edge.
A tiny white dot shows below and right of the crosshair, drifting slowly right.
The ship crosses once more, close and slanted, from the lower left to the top left; the dot stays below right of the crosshair.
The white dot drifts down to the bottom edge of the frame, then slightly left, to the end.
